tasks.short: Conduct employee background investigations and review them.

steps.what: Conduct employee background investigations and write the findings.
Review the reports with operational managers and human resources managers.

tasks.design: She conducts the employee background investigation and writes the findings herself, then reviews those reports with the operational and human resources managers. No tool is added, and nothing about the investigation or the review is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Judging a person's history, and what may be looked up, does not reduce to a field check.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that judgement. The investigation and the review stay with her.
tasks.still_hard: Special-category details and the least intrusive method stay a judgement, and the managers still hear the report in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the findings mean and what to tell the managers.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still conducts the investigation and still reviews the report with the managers.

reach.task: Note which employee was on the floor during the incident she is investigating.
reach.learn: Which shift the guard actually saw.

evidence.claim: Conducting the employee background investigation and reviewing the report with managers stay with the specialist. The digest records no measured case for background checks in this role.
The privacy code requires the least intrusive method and a proportionality weighing before a search. This design does not run a search for her.
Annex III point 4(a) covers AI used for pre-employment checks. This design adds no such system.
A recherchebureau needs a Justis licence and screened investigators. This design does not set up a recherchebureau.

assumptions: One employee investigation inside the organisation. She does not send the report outside the organisation. The review is a meeting with managers. There is no structured input and no tool, so there is no field map to keep and the upkeep allowance is zero.
The review step is 31 because the in-person means share is 30.4. The investigation holds the document, screen, workbook and mail shares.
This employer is not treated as a recherchebureau. When she writes the report she records the person, the reason, the method and the finding herself.
unknowns: Whether this employer already asks an outside screening firm to run these investigations.
Whether national rules require a recherche licence for in-house loss prevention.
research_questions: Which findings the human resources manager must hear before the review can close?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The investigation and the review with the managers stay with her on every case, so this task saves none.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still conducts each employee background investigation and still reviews the report with the managers. Nothing is drafted for her.
reach: The security guard notes which employee was on the floor during the incident she is investigating.
skills_to_grow: Weighing the least intrusive method before looking into a person.
Which findings the human resources manager needs before the review.
role.ambitious_version: She still decides whether the findings support a concern. The review with the managers stays in the room.
